business_scope.primary_industry_name: Consumer Polling and Cross-Border Market Research Platform

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (International Companies Regime administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid legal system combining English Common Law, French Civil Law, and indigenous Customary (Kastom) Law; unitary national jurisdiction with no sub-state tax divisions
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Tax Information Exchange Agreement between Vanuatu and Australia (2011)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement between Vanuatu and New Zealand (2011)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus), in force 2021

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (Vanuatu), as amended by the Companies and International Companies (Amendment) Act No. 34 of 2021 (Statutory UBO register regime); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 17 of 2017, as amended; AML/CFT Regulations 2021; Financial Services Commission Act [Cap 250]; FATF Mutual Evaluation Report and enhanced follow-up obligations

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport for each proposed director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of residence of each individual
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Vanuatu is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; authentication via Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Port Vila, or a Vanuatu diplomatic/consular post, or through local British High Commission consular services where no Vanuatu post exists)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Incumbency for each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or licensed registered agent of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization path as above; if shareholder jurisdiction is an Apostille member, Apostille certification is accepted as the pre-legalization step

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter and bankers' good conduct letter
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing private bank or licensed financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization; bank officer signature notarized at originating jurisdiction before legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and constitutional documents (memorandum/articles) of any parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of the parent entity's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization path as above, or Apostille where the parent jurisdiction is an Apostille member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified English translation of all source-language documents (Bislama, French, or Chinese)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by consular legalization chain

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all proposed directors, shareholders, and UBOs against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, UK HMT Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and Vanuatu domestic sanctions listings, together with PEP status determination under FATF Recommendation 12 and Part 4 of the AML/CFT Act No. 17 of 2017; adverse media and source-of-funds verification required for any PEP or high-risk jurisdiction match; enhanced due diligence mandatory for sanctioned or grey-listed counterparties. A licensed TCSP must retain CDD records for at least five years post-cessation of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Online Company Registry and Integrated Computer System, accessible via www.vfsc.vu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Official working languages are English and French. All corporate names must be expressed in the Roman (Latin) script; names originating in Bislama, French, or any non-Latin script must be romanized/transliterated for VFSC database entry. An International Company name must end with 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Société Anonyme', or an accepted abbreviation (Ltd, Corp, Inc, SA). The proposed name must not be identical or deceptively similar to any existing or reserved company name, and must not imply a connection to the Vanuatu Government or any foreign government.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the VFSC Registrar issues a written notice citing the statutory ground under Sections 6 and 8 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222]. A formal administrative appeal must be lodged through the licensed registered agent within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, attaching a letter of objection, the VFSC rejection reference, and a revised or substituted name. If the Registrar upholds the rejection, a further appeal lies to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu by originating motion within 21 calendar days. Alternatively, the applicant may immediately re-file with a materially different name and pay a fresh name-search fee. Name reservations may be extended by payment of an additional reservation fee prior to expiry.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible only as a supplementary communications address for back-office correspondence of the consumer panel survey platform. Statutory domicile nonetheless requires a physical registered office in Port Vila supplied by a licensed Vanuatu registered agent, which must accept service of process and keep statutory records; a pure virtual office cannot satisfy Section 78 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222].
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low to Moderate: approximately 10-15% annual likelihood of regulatory inspection or agent-site compliance visit given Vanuatu's FATF enhanced follow-up status and VFSC supervision of licensed TCSPs; unannounced physical inspection of the remote SaaS client's own premises is assessed at below 5%. VFSC on-site scrutiny focuses on the licensed agent's offices, CDD files, and UBO register rather than the platform's cloud infrastructure.

International Company incorporation filing fee (standard authorized capital up to USD 50,000)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory incorporation tariff under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark of licensed TCSPs in Port Vila

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO register filing, statutory CDD file preparation, and KYC processing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for AML/CFT compliance packages

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, and consolidated sanctions screening plus adverse media report
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed TCSP / third-party compliance screening vendor
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per beneficial ownership layer screened

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular fee schedule and courier handling

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified English translation and notarization of source-language documents
International courier delivery of originals to Vanuatu registered agent
First-year annual license fee (pro-rated to incorporation date)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory annual maintenance tariff for International Companies

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act (Cap 222), as amended, ss. 3, 8, 12, 17 and 19; Companies (Amendment) Act 2012
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registrar of International Companies, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 (Application for Registration of an International Company) together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; no escrow account requirement; authorized share capital commonly set at USD 50,000
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) That the Memorandum and Articles of Association be adopted in the form filed; one ordinary share of VUV/USD 1 be issued to the founding subscriber for full paid-up consideration. (2) That the registered office at the address of the licensed registered agent be adopted, with the agent authorized to receive service of process. (3) That the Director and Secretary named above be appointed to hold office until the next annual general meeting, with authority to open bank accounts and execute all contracts. (4) That the incorporation expenses be approved and this minute be signed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Registered Agent Engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Online Portal / licensed registered agent in Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application via a VFSC-authorized registered agent; verify the availability of the proposed company name; execute an engagement letter with the registered agent for the provision of a registered office in Vanuatu.
required_dossiers: Proof of identity of natural person subscribers/directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, file a secondary name request without additional fee within 2 business days or appeal to the VFSC Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public in Vanuatu (accepted by VFSC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in the statutory form; have each subscriber sign before a notary; attach the registered agent's written consent to act as registered office holder.
required_dossiers: Certificate of identity for each officer/shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Resubmit corrected documents to the notary; clerical errors may be cured by filing a rectification statement with the VFSC.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registrar of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-1 together with the notarized constitutional documents and agent consent through the VFSC e-registry; pay the prescribed filing fee via bank transfer or VFSC-accepted electronic payment.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried due to deficient attachments, respond to the VFSC query notice within 14 days with amended documents; a late response may require a fresh filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation and First Board Meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon clearance, VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation and assigns the International Company number; the sole director convenes the first board meeting, adopts the registered office, appoints officers, and records the pro-forma resolution in the minute book.
required_dossiers: Pro forma board resolution from schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains an error, apply for administrative rectification by statutory declaration under section 19 of the International Companies Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the register of directors and shareholders, obtain a company seal if required, open a corporate bank account at a Vanuatu or agent bank, and file annual returns with VFSC at the end of the registration year.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: For late annual returns, submit a voluntary compliance letter and pay the prescribed late fee to VFSC; repeat non-compliance may lead to deregistration, which may be remedied by an application for reinstatement under the Act.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – no industrial licensing regime applies to a digital market research and consumer polling platform operating as a Vanuatu International Company
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required; the Certificate of Incorporation under the International Companies Act constitutes the sole operational authorization

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – no physical manufacturing, discharge, or land disturbance; no EIA required for pure data processing activities
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable; if a physical office lease is entered, waste handling and sewage must comply with the Waste Management and Pollution Control Regulations; no industrial wastewater or VOC thresholds applicable

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable for non-industrial premises; any physical office in Vanuatu must meet the National Fire Service Act certification standards and the Health and Safety at Work Act (Cap 89) workplace clearance if resident employees are engaged

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Service (VCIRS), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; corporate and offshore company registry administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC); official portal: https://www.vanuatu.tax
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) incorporated under the Vanuatu International Companies Act applies to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission in Port Vila for a certificate of incorporation and a VFSC registration number; no separate tax identification number is required for foreign-owned tax-exempt ICs. If taxable supplies are made within Vanuatu and the statutory VAT threshold is exceeded, the IC must submit a VAT registration application to the Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Service, supplying certified corporate documents, proof of registered office, and anticipated turnover figures.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu does not operate a check-the-box pass-through election; an International Company is statutorily classified as a tax-exempt offshore entity and is exempt from Vanuatu income tax, capital gains tax, and withholding tax. A taxpayer may elect to treat the IC as outside the scope of VAT where all supplies are made to non-residents or are export-related; hybrid mismatch elections are not applicable because Vanuatu levies no direct corporate income tax.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 10,000,000 annual turnover for local taxable supplies; international companies supplying exclusively offshore services are not required to register for VAT regardless of turnover
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API-based e-invoicing, or digital stamping regime is currently mandated in Vanuatu. Standard invoices and source documentation must be retained for VAT audit purposes; export zero-rating claims require documentary evidence of offshore supply.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available for the export of goods from Vanuatu and for supplies of services made to non-residents, provided the supplier retains documentary evidence that the goods left Vanuatu or the services were performed wholly outside Vanuatu and the recipient is a taxable person outside Vanuatu.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bank payment confirmation evidencing receipt of consideration
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating claims are subject to retrospective VAT assessments, statutory interest on underpaid tax, financial penalties of up to double the tax under-declared, and criminal prosecution under the Vanuatu Value Added Tax Act and Customs and Inland Revenue Service legislation; directors and company agents may be jointly and severally liable for clawback amounts.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV). The RBV administers the Exchange Control Act [Cap 78] and supervises foreign-exchange dealers licensed under the Financial Dealers Act [Cap 225]; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) registers and supervises International Companies under the International Companies Act [Cap 222].
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu has accepted IMF Article VIII obligations (since 1 December 1982), so the Vatu (VUV) is freely convertible for current-account payments. Domestic-resident capital transfers formally require exchange-control approval, but an International Company is treated as a non-resident offshore entity and is expressly exempt from the Exchange Control Act; consequently, equity injection, dividend remittance, and liquidation distributions of VU_IC require no RBV permit. Residual convertibility hurdles are bank-level only: source-of-funds verification, Financial Intelligence Unit large-value reporting, and the impossibility of converting if the IC has contracted impermissibly with Vanuatu residents.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender or mandatory conversion ratio applies to an International Company. The Exchange Control Act exemption in the International Companies Act allows survey-platform receipts (export of services under ISIC 7320) to be retained indefinitely in USD, EUR, AUD, or GBP without conversion to VUV or repatriation to a Vanuatu clearing account. Compliance condition: the IC must not invoice or distribute to Vanuatu residents, or it forfeits both the exemption and banking viability.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account - USD multi-currency business settlement (Capital Escrow Account available pre-deployment)
Operational Account - foreign-currency (USD/AUD) corporate current account
Operational Account - USD/offshore corporate account with e-banking
Operational Account - VUV and minor foreign-currency account; IC onboarding discretionary

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Restricted. Wise Business and PayPal Mass Payout hold no Vanuatu banking licence, generally refuse to open settlement accounts for Vanuatu-incorporated International Companies, and offer no VUV-denominated balances. Legally, the Financial Dealers Act [Cap 225] bars an unlicensed IC from acting as a payment intermediary for third parties, so Wise and PayPal are usable strictly as outbound disbursement processors for consumer panelists, prefunded from the licensed Vanuatu bank account, with residual balances swept back weekly. The primary treasury and statutory-capital relationship must therefore sit with ANZ, BSP, or BRED.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance is effectively mandatory for first-time corporate onboarding: ANZ, BSP, and BRED require the beneficial owner or a director to appear in person at the Port Vila branch for the compliance interview. Remote account opening is not offered to new IC clients; an introducer pathway with certified copies and video verification occasionally succeeds but carries low approval odds and extended processing. The interview covers ownership, source of wealth, expected transaction flows, counterparty jurisdictions, and the mass-payout distribution model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident beneficial owner with no Vanuatu footprint, no local reference, and no prior relationship with the bank
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified true copies of the Certificate of Incorporation and IC register extract issued by a VFSC-licensed registered agent; executed board resolution designating account signatories; bank reference letter from the beneficial owner's current bank; three months of personal bank statements; signed source-of-wealth statement; certified passport and utility-bill proof of address; receipt of the latest VFSC annual fee evidencing good standing.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mass-payout-to-consumers pattern resembling layering, structuring, or third-party settlement
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: IC AML/CTF compliance manual with eKYC and sanctions-screening procedures for panelists; executed contract with Wise/PayPal confirming identity verification and anti-fraud screening on each payout; payout-frequency and per-user cap tables; system audit logs showing deterministic amounts without deliberate splitting; client master-service agreements and invoices evidencing the ISIC 7320 market-research purpose; reconciliation reports between prefunding transfers and disbursed panel funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opacity in source of funds for initial share capital or settlement of invoices routed from higher-risk regions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed subscription agreement and share-allotment resolution for the capital injection; bank statements of the remitting corporate account; itemized client invoices tied to sample sizes and survey panels; shareholder-loan agreements with repayment mechanics; a signed declaration that no funds derive from cryptocurrency or unlicensed money services; consent to the Vanuatu bank retrieving correspondent-bank references on the remitter.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Jurisdiction-risk flags from Vanuatu's enhanced FATF monitoring status and the IC's offshore tax-exempt identity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Port Vila legal opinion confirming the IC's lawful tax-exempt status and Exchange Control Act exemption; VFSC certificate of good standing; registered-agent annual declaration; completed correspondent-bank KYC questionnaire; statutory registers maintained at the registered office; geoblocking evidence excluding Vanuatu residents from panel membership and onshore revenue.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route shareholder capital by SWIFT MT103 from the remitting bank through an Australian or US correspondent and into the IC's operational USD account at ANZ, BSP, or BRED in Port Vila. The wire narrative must state 'SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION - INTERNATIONAL COMPANY VU_IC' together with the registered company number; the bank requires 48-hour pre-notification comprising the share-allotment resolution, the registered-agent certificate, and a source-of-funds letter. No RBV capital-import certificate or exchange-control approval is required for the IC, but the bank records the credit for FIU large-value reporting (threshold VUV 1,000,000, approximately USD 8,500). If capital is being escrowed pending regulatory or commercial milestones, designate a Capital Escrow Account at the same bank and transfer to the operating account via an internal journal entry evidenced by board minutes.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary distribution rails are PayPal Mass Payout API for consumer panelists and Wise Business for banked panelists and SaaS vendor payments; both are prefunded via SWIFT MT103 from the Vanuatu operating account and swept back weekly to minimize processor custodian risk. Corporate trade settlements with fieldwork and data vendors use standard SWIFT MT103 (with 'SERVICE FEES - MARKET RESEARCH' narrative) and MT202 for correspondent cover when bank charges are split. Commercial Letters of Credit are legally available without RBV approval but are uneconomic for recurring subscription flows and should be reserved for one-off high-value procurement of panel-book inventory. Outgoing transfers carry no statutory cap; only the bank's AML/CTF large-value reporting and the prohibition on payments to Vanuatu residents constrain the treasury.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable FX forwards (USD/VUV, USD/AUD, EUR/USD) with ANZ, BSP, or BRED, tenor up to 12 months, subject to a bilateral FX line and no RBV approval due to the IC's Exchange Control Act exemption
Cross-currency swaps (USD/EUR, USD/AUD, USD/GBP) with licensed banking counterparties, documented in IC board minutes and used only to hedge panel-payout and vendor-invoice currency mismatches

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on VUV and less-liquid Pacific currencies arranged offshore through an Australian or Singaporean authorised dealer; legally permitted for the IC but constrained by shallow liquidity and maximum tenors of roughly six months

Zero-cost collar and forward-band structures available once the bank credit committee approves an FX limit; only plain-vanilla, non-leveraged hedging instruments are advisable to preserve the IC's exempt offshore status

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one calendar month following the anniversary date of incorporation; recurring annual anniversary-based cycle
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: VFSC late filing penalty accrues monthly; company loses Certificate of Good Standing and cannot obtain certified extracts; persistent default exceeding 12 months triggers administrative strike-off and deregistration, requiring payment of all outstanding government fees plus reinstatement charges before restoration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation (UBO Register Annual Declaration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC via the licensed registered agent at the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the incorporation anniversary date, concurrent with the annual return filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory fines against the company and directors; non-compliance with the anti-money laundering UBO disclosure regime may lead to VFSC enforcement, suspension of corporate records, loss of good standing, and eventual administrative strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory independent audit for a Vanuatu International Company conducting no business with Vanuatu residents and not managed or controlled in Vanuatu; mandatory audit applies where the IC holds a VFSC licence (securities, banking, insurance), is managed and controlled within Vanuatu, holds resident assets, or where shareholders holding at least 10% of voting rights require audited accounts
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) or IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities; financial statements must present a true and fair view and may be prepared in any currency under the Vanuatu International Companies Act

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed registered agent must obtain and verify beneficial ownership particulars on incorporation and on any share transfer; any change in shareholding or UBO details must be notified to the registered agent within 14 days; an annual confirmation statement verifying current beneficial owners is submitted to VFSC together with the annual return; omissions render the company and its directors jointly liable to statutory penalties

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $1,000–$2,000 per annum including licensed registered agent, registered office, corporate secretarial maintenance, and annual return preparation
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $1,500–$4,000 per annum for licensed or audit-triggered entities; nil for exempt non-resident ICs without local Vanuatu activity

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Complete statutory exemption for International Companies: 0% corporate income tax, 0% capital gains tax, 0% dividend withholding tax, and 0% tax on business profits. No preferential tax holiday is required because the IC is wholly outside Vanuatu income tax. The only annual public charge is the VFSC registration/renewal fee.
